subject: MAP kickoff & evaluation timeline for NovaMed
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novamed.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — NovaMed evaluation timeline

Hi Samir —

Great to meet on the call earlier. As discussed, I wanted to capture a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align on success criteria and a target close timeline so your team can map internal approvals. High-level goals we heard:

- Validate Redwood inference latency and cost on NovaMed sample workloads (10k tokens/day prototype)
- Confirm security & data handling for PHI-adjacent telemetry
- Produce an internal ROI estimate for IT & Procurement by the end of August

Attached is a compact MAP template to kick things off (novamed-map-template-v1.xlsx). Can you confirm:
1) Primary champion (is Samir the single point?)
2) Target close date you’d like us to aim for (end of Aug / mid-Sep / other)
3) Any mandatory stakeholders we should add now (security, legal, procurement, engineering)

Proposed next step: 30–45 minute MAP kickoff next week to assign owners and book follow-ups. I’m free Tue/Wed morning PT.

I’ve also linked a draft MAP here for collaborative edits: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2bMapDraft

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: novamed-map-template-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 48KB)
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novamed.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — NovaMed evaluation timeline

Aditya —

Thanks for pulling this together and for the doc link. Confirming I will be the champion for this evaluation and can drive the technical trial. High-level responses:

- Target close: we are aiming to decide by 2026-08-27 (end of month) so vendor selection and initial PO can be in September.
- Stakeholders to include now: Amanda Liu (VP Data & Analytics), James Hollis (Head of InfoSec — james.hollis@novamed.com), and procurement@novamed.com.
- On security: James will need the dataflow diagram and a short note on retention and audit logs. We may ask for a short SOC2 evidence pack during the trial.

I’m available for a kickoff Tue 13 Jul at 10am ET / 7am PT; if that slot is firm for you, please send an invite.

On attachments: the MAP template looks good — I’ll add our internal timeline and initial success metrics (latency <150ms p50 on the sample traces, and accuracy benchmarks vs. our current baseline).

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Director, Data & AI | NovaMed Health
samir.patel@novamed.com | +1 (212) 555-4466

Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — NovaMed evaluation timeline

All —

Thanks Samir, that timeline is helpful. Quick internal notes and proposed owners so we come to the kickoff prepared:

- Aditya: owner for commercial timeline and procurement runbooks (deal & PO path, pricing comps).
- Marissa: owner for onboarding and evaluation success metrics, will coordinate runbooks with NovaMed engineering.
- Laura (me): owner for solution design and pilot config, will prepare sample workload guidance and latency measurement plan.
- Security packet: Aditya, please pull the SOC2 summary + dataflow diagram; Marissa will add the onboarding checklist.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 13 Jul 2026 at 07:00 PT / 10:00 ET — 30 minutes to align owners and confirm milestones. If that works for Samir/Amanda/James, I’ll send the calendar invite and include a short agenda (owners, success metrics, security asks, procurement timeline).

Prep items for the meeting (we should have these in the doc ahead of time):
- Initial MAP with owners assigned (Aditya will seed commercial items; Marissa will seed onboarding steps)
- Sample log/traces that NovaMed will provide (Samir: a sanitized sample is fine)
- Security checklist and expected evidence (James: will list hard requirements)

I’ll attach the whitepaper on our data processing model for reference: redwood-data-processing-whitepaper.pdf.

Laura Bennett
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-2133

Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan kickoff — NovaMed evaluation timeline (calendar + MAP)

Samir / team —

Thanks — that time works. I’ve booked a 30-minute kickoff for Tue, 13 Jul 2026 at 07:00 PT / 10:00 ET and attached a short agenda. Invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=novamed-map-kickoff

What I’ve added to the shared MAP (docs link):
- Commercial milestones: target PO by 2026-09-01, internal exec review by 2026-08-20.
- Success metrics: latency p50 target 150ms, throughput target for prototype 1k reqs/day.
- Owners column populated with internal owners (Aditya/Laura/Marissa) and external contacts per Samir’s list.

Prep before kickoff: Samir — can you drop a sanitized 24–48 hour sample and James, if you can share a quick note on retention expectations that would be great. Marissa and I will pull together the onboarding checklist and SOC2 summary PDF (attached).

See you Tuesday.

Aditya Rao
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
